rule.statement: A corporation established for a charitable purpose is a charitable institution and also a company.
rule.supporting_quote: A corporation established for a charitable purpose is a charitable institution. That same corporation when it comes to being taxed is a company.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: the Colombo Young Men's Buddhist Association Ordinance No. 11 of 1927 and the Inland Revenue Act No. 38 of 2000 (as amended) and Section 217 of the Inland Revenue Act No. 10 of 2006 (as amended)
